rightsReview.disposition: Four inherited illustrations remain in the local preview; no independent permission asserted for release. The existing repository-owner statements are not substitutes for an upstream grant.

checked.finding: The exact arXiv version points to permission granted to arXiv. The publisher describes its own non-exclusive license, not a general grant to readers.

Cookbook instructions link to a separate image dataset. The dataset card has no license metadata; the frozen dataset README contains no grant. Do not extend the cookbook code license to these image files.

The course page links to slides without an explicit reuse grant. The paper points to arXiv's distribution license; the separate MIT software license does not establish permission for the Berkeley slide.

validation.figures: All eight alt descriptions served in both locales. Previous exact original PNGs and source captions preserved; all source and pixel checks reran successfully.
validation.reader: Native Russian mobile reference click to context budgeting and English desktop reference click to HippoRAG, both visually inspected. Final rendered figures loaded with correct aspect ratios and no page overflow at 375 and 1280 px.
validation.preservation: The reversible three-file change restores the previous RAG and both indexes exactly, including every old anchor.

next: Resolve the four inherited figure permissions or find explicitly licensed originals before release.
